TC-23/S15.title: Dictated bare temperature: kept as dictated on the panel; the model summary adds °C
TC-23/S15.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a, deployed 2026-10-20 02:04 JST), live models, under runs/.dev.lock; only prefixed rows created and all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Unit U38 (run-plan-dev.json). As on 43c38a4f: the Vitals panel and the stored value keep the bare '38' in both modes (this ticket's half passes) and the first Save Note keeps 38.4 / 37.9 °C; the model-written admission summary says 'temperature 38°C overnight', which the unit's wider scan flags. Whether adding the unit counts as an invented unit is decision D2 (Preston): needs a person, not counted. Recorded: each pre-round Save Note took about 30–60 s on dev (agent's notes).
